Container.Name: YAMZ
Container.Overview: YAMZ (Yet Another Media Zombie) is a good-looking browser for your movie and TV collection. Connect Plex or Jellyfin and get a poster wall with ratings, cast and photos, a Gaps page that finds what's missing from your franchises and TV seasons, Discover (Popular, Upcoming, Recent and Essentials by genre and decade), your own Lists, a release Calendar, Plex Watchlist sync, and one-click adding to Radarr and Sonarr. Everything is stored in /config and protected by its own sign-in. Open the WebUI and create your account on first run. Note: YAMZ is tested day to day with Plex. Jellyfin support should work but still needs more real-world testing.
Container.Requires: A Plex or Jellyfin server reachable from this container (or plain media folders). Radarr, Sonarr, TMDB and OMDb keys are optional extras.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port for the YAMZ web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Where YAMZ keeps its settings, lists, account and cache.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID YAMZ runs as (Unraid default: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID YAMZ runs as (Unraid default: 100 = users).

Config.Name: Sign-in
Config.Description: Keep 'on'. Choose 'none' ONLY if a reverse proxy in front of YAMZ already requires a login (Authelia, Authentik, etc.).

Config.Name: Behind a reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set to true when you reach YAMZ through a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik, Caddy). Enables secure cookies over https and correct client addresses for sign-in protection.

Config.Name: Allow self-signed certificates
Config.Description: Set to true if your Plex, Jellyfin, Radarr or Sonarr use https with a self-signed certificate.

Config.Name: Base path
Config.Description: Only needed if your reverse proxy serves YAMZ under a sub-folder (e.g. /yamz) WITHOUT stripping it. Leave empty otherwise.

Config.Name: Initial username
Config.Description: Optional. Creates this account on first start instead of the in-browser setup screen.

Config.Name: Initial password
Config.Description: Optional. Password for the initial account (at least 8 characters). You can remove it after the first start.
